title: Expose the shared image workflow in the Papyrus CLI
description:
As an editor or agent using the CLI, I want to search, generate, inspect and apply image candidates so that I can curate an item without manually reproducing newsroom internals.

Feature: Image curation from the command line
  Scenario: Search and apply a candidate
    Given I am authorized for the selected site and item
    When I search for images and apply a returned candidate
    Then the item and image metadata match the result of using the shared image service
  Scenario: Request a generated round
    Given a generation provider has been configured
    When I request generated image candidates with a brief
    Then the CLI returns identifiers and provenance suitable for inspection and selection
  Scenario: A selection cannot be applied
    Given an invalid or unauthorized image selection
    When I attempt to apply it
    Then the CLI reports an actionable error without changing the item

Provide machine-readable output and predictable errors; support current site selection and auth, and do not depend on browser UI or unavailable story commands.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Under the new epic PPY-3ec25c. The papyrus images commands are generated from the shared operation table (PPY-1232dc), identical in names, arguments, JSON and errors to the MCP tools.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PPY-5377ad now tracks the signed-in CLI acceptance flow for Claude Code and Gemini as callers of the OpenAI-backed Papyrus image service. On Machines on Machines, Papyrus CLI 5.103.0 advertised the commands, but read-only image capabilities and prompt preview returned not_implemented. Profile get returned not_found for the publication. The existing save-version --images workflow uploaded and published both Day and Night covers successfully. Use that as the fallback example while the integrated flow is being built.
